_fixtureNote: CONSTRUCTED 2026-10-23. Suggested starting weights for RaceLens factor keys (src/server/core/factors.ts BASE_WEIGHTS). Not fitted to data; see research/modelknowledge.md section 13 for justification. Re-fit weekly from stored results.

evidence.claim: BSP calibration tracks implied probability closely except sub-$1.20 noise
Majority of Betfair volume traded in last 2-5 minutes; >10 min prices unreliable
Benter combined fundamental logit with public odds in a second stage

recentForm.why: Core of every published model; decay 0.4/0.25/0.15/0.12/0.08 over last 5 runs; normalise by class and margin.

classSuitability.why: Apparent weight effects are mostly class effects (Doncaster 56.5kg carriers won 64% of head-to-heads).

trackDistance.why: Course/distance/track-condition records are standard AU form columns; shrink small samples (prior ~6 starts).

wetForm.why: Applies only when rating >= Soft 5; ramps 0.4 at Soft 5 to 1.0 at Heavy 10; sire fallback at quarter strength.

barrier.why: Track-geometry priors (barrier-priors.json) plus day-pattern learning; weak on Flemington straight, strong at Moonee Valley 1200m and Caulfield 1600m.

pace.why: On-pace advantage pervasive on small tracks, slow tempo, rail out; make race-scenario aware (lone leader vs contested).

jockey.why: Real but priced and confounded with mount quality; hot-hand strategies return negative.

trainer.why: Elite stables 12-14% overall; stable first-up/second-up patterns belong in fitness.

weight.why: Weak/confounded; use change vs last start and relative weight after apprentice claim.

fitness.why: First-up 10-12%, second-up 10-12%, third-up 17-18% for big AU stables; DLR sweet spot 14-28 days.

careerStrike.why: Win% and place% informative but overlap with form/class; shrink for <6 starts.

sourceRatings.why: Published ratings are strong but partly reflect the market; avoid double counting with the blend.

moneyMove.why: Steamers win ~5.5% more often than drifters but lose more at BSP; the information is already in the blended market probability.

news.why: Matters mainly for scratch risk / stable intent; require 2-source verification.

gear.why: UK first-time blinkers 8.5% SR, -15.3% ROI on average; positive only when market-supported.

lineage.why: Fallback when form is missing (debut, first wet track, new distance).

conditionsVolatility.description: Shrink all fundamental scores toward 0 by this factor and add it to beta (capped 0.8).
